dict.string: The &RVan-o-saurus is able to withstand a full frontal assault from a &YTriceratops! Hopefully you won’t have to see it happen though...

Alright &Plisten &Pup! You’ve been invited to the &RJurassic &RParking, better &Bget &Bthere &Bon &Btime!
We’re gonna go take a look at the &Rdinos now. Better be &Bcareful!
Arr, very interesting. some of those dinosaurs seem to &Bspit &Bvenom! Ve should get you some &Rprotective &Rglasses unless you want to end &Pblind, ya?
EYO MAN, putting us in cages? &RNot &Rcool &Rbro. See if you can &Bcatch &Bus now, loser!
&RFINALLY &RFREE! I AM GONNA &RWRECK &REVERYTHING! DON’T EVEN TRY TO STOP ME— oooooh &Yshiny!
You’re &Bstill &Balive! Good for you! We need to &Rcall &Rfor &Rrescue now or we’re &Pdino &Pdinner!
Greetings &Rfellow &Rhumans! I am totally &Bone &Bof &Byours! Say, I heard you were leaving the island? Do you mind if we take some &Praptor &Peggs with us? It’s for, er. &Kmy &Kresearch!
Ah yes, very good! Gather more eggs and I will be able to create my &Rraptor &Rarmy. I-I mean &Pmake &Pastounding &Pscientific &Pdiscoveries for all of mankind!
